propositions: Completion verifier returns non-deterministic verdicts (PASS vs FAIL) on identical inputs (same ticket, code, criteria) within minutes, due to unpinned LLM sampling variance in test-existence judgment.

Verifier's test-existence crediting flips between runs because free-form search queries are non-deterministic (semantic/regex queries no-match while literal substring searches hit the same test file).
COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecar lacks verified_at_sha, trace_id, and input snapshot metadata, making it impossible to diagnose non-determinism from stored records alone.

False-negative test verdicts block legitimate, complete tickets non-deterministically (e.g., ad9f marked incomplete due to missing tests that exist; 4de6 blocked despite existing test in *_4de6.py file).
Completion verifier's temperature is unpinned (sampling variance), differing from the plan-review Pass-2 verifier's greedy pin (temperature 0), introducing unnecessary verdict variance.
